info.title: Field Planner Service API
info.description:
REST API for the eGov DIGIT field-planner service. Field Plans are modelled as time-bound Projects (projectType=FieldPlan) that group field activities and can be linked to facilities.

### Authentication
This service does not use HTTP `Authorization` headers. Every non-health request body wraps a `RequestInfo` object, and authentication is carried entirely inside `RequestInfo.authToken` — the Bearer JWT access token issued by egov-user's OAuth login endpoints (`POST /user/oauth/token` or `POST /user/_login`). The token must be paired with `RequestInfo.userInfo`, which carries the authenticated user's `uuid`, `userName` and `roles`. Requests with a missing/invalid `authToken` or missing `userInfo`/`uuid` are rejected with a 400 `CustomException` (see the `ErrorRes` schema) by egov-tracer's default exception handling — field-planner does not define its own error DTO.

The `GET /health` endpoint is an unauthenticated liveness/readiness probe and requires no `RequestInfo`.

post.summary: Create one or more Field Plans
post.description: Validates the request (RequestInfo/UserInfo presence, mandatory FieldPlan fields, start/end date rules, and cross-checks against the referenced Project and MDMS master data), enriches each FieldPlan with a generated id and audit details, persists it and asynchronously pushes it to the `fieldPlan.management.system.kafka.create.topic` (save-field-plan) Kafka topic. Returns the enriched FieldPlans that were accepted for creation.

requestBody.description: Capture details of the Field Plan (beneficiary/facility field-plan) to be created.

202.description: Accepted. The Field Plans were validated and queued/persisted successfully.

400.description: Bad Request. Raised as a `CustomException` (e.g. missing RequestInfo/UserInfo, missing mandatory FieldPlan fields, invalid/unknown Project ID, FieldPlan dates outside the Project's dates, start date not before end date, or the FieldPlan's tenant/state not present in MDMS).

post.summary: Update one or more existing Field Plans
post.description: Validates RequestInfo/UserInfo, mandatory FieldPlan fields, that every FieldPlan carries the same tenantId, that each FieldPlan has an `id`, and that the requested start/end date changes are legal against the persisted record (e.g. cannot move a start/end date that has already elapsed, changes must be at least 24 hours in advance). Persists the update and asynchronously pushes to the `fieldPlan.kafka.update.topic` (update-fieldplan) Kafka topic.

200.description: OK. The Field Plans were validated and updated successfully.

400.description: Bad Request. Raised as a `CustomException` (e.g. missing FieldPlan id, mixed tenantIds across FieldPlans, or an illegal start/end date change against the persisted record).

post.summary: Assign facilities to Field Plans in bulk
post.description: Sets `RequestInfo.apiId` to the request URI and asynchronously pushes the whole bulk request to the `fieldPlan.facility.consumer.bulk.create.topic` (save-fieldplan-facility-bulk-topic) Kafka topic for downstream validation and persistence by the consumer. The HTTP response only echoes back a `ResponseInfo` acknowledging the request was accepted for processing — it does not reflect the outcome of validation, which happens asynchronously in the consumer.

get.description: Unauthenticated liveness/readiness probe. Takes no parameters and no RequestInfo, and always returns a fixed status payload when the service process is up and able to serve HTTP traffic.

Role.description: A role assigned to a user, as returned by egov-user.

User.description: The authenticated user, embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo. Obtained from egov-user during login and echoed back on every subsequent request.

uuid.description: Unique user identifier. Mandatory — field-planner rejects requests where this is blank.

PlainAccessRequest.description: Optional egov-user plain-text field access request, passed through unchanged. Not used by field-planner.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request envelope, required on every non-health field-planner endpoint. Authentication is carried entirely by `authToken` + `userInfo` in this object — there is no separate Authorization header.

authToken.description: Bearer JWT access token obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (`POST /user/oauth/token` or `POST /user/_login`). This IS the authentication credential for field-planner — it is validated on every request in place of an HTTP Authorization header.

Error.description: A single error entry, as produced by egov-tracer's default CustomException handling.

description.description: Further description of the error (mirrors message for CustomException-derived errors).

ErrorRes.description: Standard eGov DIGIT error response, returned with HTTP 4xx/5xx by egov-tracer's default CustomException handling.

AdditionalFields.description: Schema-versioned bag of additional key/value fields.

Project.description: Simplified view of the health-services Project (org.egov.common.models.project.Project) that a Field Plan is linked to via projectId. Field Plans are themselves modelled as Projects with projectType=FieldPlan.

FieldPlan.description: A Field Plan groups a set of field activities within a date range for a tenant, and is linked 1:1 with an underlying Project (projectType=FieldPlan).

id.description: Server-generated identifier. Absent on create, required on update.

startDate.description: Epoch millis. Must be before endDate and at least 1 day earlier.

endDate.description: Epoch millis. Must be within the linked Project's start/end date range.

projectId.description: Id of the underlying Project this Field Plan represents. Mandatory on create.

geographyDetails.description: Free-form geography attributes (e.g. state, district) validated against MDMS StateInfo master data.

activities.description: List of activities for this Field Plan. Mandatory and validated against the MDMS Activities master.

FieldPlanSearchCriteria.description: Search criteria for Field Plans. At least one of ids/projectIds/statuses/fromDate/toDate (or the lastChangedSince query parameter) must be supplied.

tenantId.description: Must match the tenantId query parameter.

FieldPlanFacility.description: A linkage between a Field Plan and a Facility.

FieldPlanFacilitySearch.description: Search criteria for Field Plan - Facility linkages. If `id` is supplied, the search is performed purely by id.

HealthResponse.description: Fixed liveness/readiness payload returned by GET /health.
